rationale: PDF BaseFont 名称长度完全由输入控制，stack-buffer-overflow 写越界可覆盖返回地址

attack_vector.evidence: PDF 通过 gstoraster_fuzzer 处理，属不可信输入解析

privileges_required.evidence: 无需认证，任何 PDF 处理路径均可触发

user_interaction.evidence: 需目标程序打开恶意 PDF

observed_impact.evidence: ASAN: stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 5575 @ pdf_font.c:332

reachability_evidence.evidence: propagation.json 记录 BaseFont -> memcpy 完整链路

deployment_conditions.evidence: 官方 vul 镜像默认构建即复现
